handoff: P0 pointer arithmetic and bounds verification
scope: Minimal reproducers only. No compiler/runtime/header edits; no git add/commit.
classification_rule: Only diagnostics containing a literal '[CPLUS-' token count as tagged enforcement. tagged REJECT = nonzero exit with [CPLUS-; untagged REJECT = nonzero exit with no [CPLUS-; ACCEPT = exit 0 with no diagnostic.
control_note: The control is the fixed local int[3] literal OOB, which the current compiler already rejects with tagged [CPLUS-BOUNDS] [CPLUS-SAFE-BOUNDS]. All other cases are class-owned/stdlib buffer accesses that are currently accepted.

metadata_requirements_for_agent1.purpose: Metadata Agent 1 must attach to stdlib class buffers so pointer-arithmetic/index OOB is rejected with a tagged [CPLUS-BOUNDS] diagnostic.

items.name: Pointer-field to extent-field binding
items.detail: Bind vector::items (int*) to vector::used (logical length) and vector::space (capacity), stride sizeof(int). Bind slice::items to slice::count, with generation_ref/generation_at as staleness metadata. Apply the same pattern to string::chars / string_view::chars and their length fields.

items.name: Allocation-site capacity
items.detail: Record the element count from stdlib_alloc(sizeof(int) * n) assignments to bound pointer fields (vector::reserve, copy_from, shrink_to_fit) and propagate it into items/space.

items.name: Method-call receiver and index exposure
items.detail: Expose receiver, method and index argument to the bounds pass so v.at_checked(9,&out), v.at(9) and s.at_checked(3,&out) are checked against the receiver extent; keep runtime -1 semantics.

items.name: Interprocedural propagation
items.detail: Follow writes to bound fields in free helpers (vector_reserve(this,want)) and in vector::view(), which copies items/used into a returned slice so the borrowed value inherits the owner extent.

items.name: Pointer arithmetic with signed offsets and view construction
items.detail: Check p+k, p[k], *(p+k) and p-k against [0,extent) with signed offsets (constants, provable constants, negative offsets). For slice(base+off,count) require off>=0 and off+count<=source_extent; reject one-past-end bases and inflated counts.

items.name: Negative / unsigned index handling
items.detail: Range-constrain index parameters: flag (size_t)-1 and negative pointer offsets instead of allowing unsigned wrap.

items.name: Stable tag
items.detail: Emit exactly [CPLUS-BOUNDS] [CPLUS-SAFE-BOUNDS] (tag pair of the int[3] control) with buffer/index/extent in the message. Untagged rejection counts only as PARTIAL, not REJECT.
